kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتصد (form VIII)
# نَقْتَصِدُ (naqtaṣidu) /naq.ta.sˤi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# نُقْتَصَدُ (nuqtaṣadu) /nuq.ta.sˤa.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# نَقْتَصِدَ (naqtaṣida) /naq.ta.sˤi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# نُقْتَصَدَ (nuqtaṣada) /nuq.ta.sˤa.d
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
